_comment: The map base: a hole in hell's ground, one ring deck round the void the tower stands in. Authored in WORLD coordinates -- instance at identity: deck at y=23.0 (r 44..60) under a rock ceiling at y=31.5 (the gallery is a cutout, open toward the void), courtyard floor at y=-11.05, rim at y=330. Prison cells (arched glowing recesses with carved columns) are carved into the pit faces, visual only. One textured material (the tower's 128x128 atlas + emissive), one UV set. MapBaseCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node (flat deck, pit wall, courtyard disc, outer wall, flat ceiling); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn.
